tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; Write-Host 'Watching audit logs in:' $dir -ForegroundColor DarkGray; $seen = @{}; while ($true) { if (Test-Path $dir) { Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.FullName; if (-not $seen.ContainsKey($p)) { $seen[$p] = (Get-Content $p).Count }; $lines = Get-Content $p; if ($lines.Count -gt $seen[$p]) { $lines[$seen[$p]..($lines.Count-1)] | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\{') { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json | Format-Table -AutoSize syscall, args, result } }; $seen[$p] = $lines.Count } } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }

tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log (Pretty)
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; Write-Host 'Watching audit logs in:' $dir -ForegroundColor DarkGray; $seen = @{}; while ($true) { if (Test-Path $dir) { Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.FullName; if (-not $seen.ContainsKey($p)) { $seen[$p] = (Get-Content $p).Count; Write-Host "New session: $($_.Name)" -ForegroundColor Cyan }; $lines = Get-Content $p; if ($lines.Count -gt $seen[$p]) { $lines[$seen[$p]..($lines.Count-1)] | & 'C:\src\litebox\litebox_tool_executor\scripts\View-AuditLog.ps1'; $seen[$p] = $lines.Count } } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
